parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: The list of query filter conditions.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The filter parameter.

> For supported filter parameters and their values, refer to **Supplementary description of request parameters**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter parameter.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.
>This parameter is applicable only to Cluster Edition instances. You can specify a node to query its batch tasks. If you do not specify this parameter, the batch tasks of the primary node are returned by default.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number for the paging query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of records per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
